assertions.name: mission-is-merged-not-pr-created
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md: 'MISSION = MERGED. Not tests pass. Not PR created. Not pushed. Done = PR merged + branch deleted + main pulled.' Iron Law is explicit.

assertions.name: fresh-verification-before-shipping
assertions.evidence: Step 4: 'VERIFY - Invoke /superpowers:verification-before-completion' is an independent verification step before commit/push.

assertions.name: review-is-read-before-merge
assertions.evidence: Step 8 REVIEW: 'Fetch + read review comments' with explicit methods: 'gh pr view <N> --comments' and 'gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments'. Reading is mandatory before merge.

assertions.name: main-is-cleaned-up-after-merge
assertions.evidence: Step 11: 'CLEANUP - git checkout main && git pull'. Merge step uses '--delete-branch' flag.

assertions.name: real-bugs-fixed-before-merge
assertions.evidence: Step 9 FIX: 'Address real bugs from review'. HIGH severity = 'must fix before merge'. Classification table: 'Real bug: FIX immediately. Push fix. Re-review.'

assertions.name: review-comments-are-classified
assertions.evidence: Explicit classification table: Real bug, Security issue, Style preference, Over-engineering suggestion, False positive — each with distinct action.

assertions.name: substantive-fixes-trigger-rereview
assertions.evidence: 'After addressing reviews: git push. # Wait for another review cycle if changes were significant.'

assertions.name: false-positives-are-not-blockers
assertions.evidence: Classification table: 'False positive: SKIP. Note why.' Also: 'WRONG: blindly accepting every review comment'.

assertions.name: rejects-pr-created-as-done
assertions.evidence: 'WRONG: PR created, done! ← Mission is MERGED, not created' explicitly listed in What NOT To Do section.

assertions.name: review-remains-required-for-small-change
assertions.evidence: 'WRONG: Skip review because it is a small change ← Small changes break things too' explicitly listed.

assertions.name: completion-still-includes-merge-and-cleanup
assertions.evidence: Full loop steps 10+11: merge with --delete-branch + git checkout main && git pull. No shortcut path exists.
